faqs.q: Sec. 102-408. - Failure to comply; compliance procedures.
faqs.a:
(a)
Notice and order.
After December 31, 2026, the director shall give written notice to any property owner
               who is presumed to have an LSL on their property under
section 102-406
(c), or who have confirmed LSL on their property, informing such property owner they
               have been found to be in violation of the city's prohibition on LSL.
(1)
Contents of notice and order.
The notice and order shall set forth any order or orders stating the actions necessary
               to verify the presence of LSL and/or to replace confirmed LSL.
(i)
Presumed LSL process.
A property owner whose property contains presumed LSL shall be allowed 63 days from
               the date of the notice and order to submit documentation to the director demonstrating
               whether the presumed LSL is LSL or not. The documentation must comply with the requirements
               set forth in the notice and order.
(a)
If a presumed LSL is confirmed to be an LSL, the property owner must replace the LSL
               and submit to the director proof of the replacement within 182 days after submission
               of documentation confirming the presence of LSL. Such documentation must comply with
               the requirements set forth in the notice and order, and with the engineering standards.
               Replacement of LSL on or after January 1, 2027, shall be done at the property owner's
               expense.
(b)
Extension of the time frames in
section 102-408
(a)(1)(i) and
section 102-408
(a)(1)(i)(a), shall be at the sole discretion of the director, and may only be granted
               one time. A property owner requesting an extension must submit a written request to
               the director, explaining the reasons for the request, at least 28 days prior to the
               end of these time frames above.
(ii)
Confirmed LSL process.
A property owner whose property contains confirmed LSL, whether previously known
               or newly discovered, must replace the LSL and submit to the director proof of replacement
               within 182 days from the date of the notice and order. Such documentation must comply
               with the requirements set forth in the notice and order, and with the engineering
               standards. Replacement of LSL on or after January 1, 2027, shall be done at the property
               owner's expense.
(a)
Extension of the 182-day time frame in
section 102-408
(a)(1)(ii) shall be at the sole discretion of the director and may only be granted
               one time. A property owner requesting an extension must submit a written request to
               the director, explaining the reasons for the request, at least 28 days prior to the
               end of the time frame above.
(b)
Violation notice.
If a property owner fails to comply with the order or orders of the director within
               the time frame specified in the notice and order issued under
section 102-408
(a) above, the director shall send a violation notice to the property owner. The violation
               notice shall be sent to the property owner within 21 days after the property owner's
               compliance period has expired.
(1)
Contents.
The violation notice shall re-state the order or orders stating the actions necessary
               to verify the presence of LSL and to replace confirmed LSL. The notice of violation
               shall remind the property owner of the obligation to comply with the order or orders
               of the director. The notice of violation will include notice of the civil penalty
               that will be imposed under
section 102-409
for failure to comply.
(2)
Subsequent violation notice.
A property owner who has not complied with the order or orders of the direction within
               one year from the date of the notice and order, shall be sent a notice of violation
               every year until compliance is attained. Each subsequent notice of violation shall
               impose an additional civil penalty imposed under
section 102-409
for the continued failure to comply.
(c)
Mailing and posting of notices.
Each notice and order or violation notice issued under this section shall be mailed
               to the property owner by first class U.S. Mail, at the address on file with the applicable
               county tax assessor's office or alternate address provided by the property owner.
               Each notice must state any appeal available. The city's inability to comply strictly
               with the time deadlines set forth herein for the mailing or posting of a notice and
               order or a violation notice shall not impact the enforcement action.
(
Ord. No. 4869
, § 1, 3-4-2024)
